'''2001 Montana State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Billings, Montana on 28 April 2001. [[Jeremy LaMere]] won it. It is known from Jeremy LaMere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2187">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-billings-mt-4-28-2001-statesd2187/ billings-mt-4-28-2001-states], DeckTech (Jeremy "jerome" LaMere, 29 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-billings-mt-4-28-2001-statesd2187/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Billings, Montana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jeremy LaMere]]
